findings.detail: [[items-chg]]: The requirement to enter 'CERT OK' and the certificate document reference in the approval comment for lithium-cell flagged CHG- items originates only from an email and has not been incorporated into formal procurement policy or SOPs.

[[man-inv-72]]: The page references and cites old/MAN-INV-72 Inventory v7.2.2 (old).pdf for active sections and screen functionality (including INV-WHS-01, INV-ITM-01, INV-CCP-14, INV-QCH-11, INV-RES-12, INV-KBN-13, INV-PKG-15, INV-SCR-16, INV-CSG-17, and INV-STK-03) which are already incorporated into the current v7.2.3 manual.

[[pol-qua-005]]: Operational quality controls such as frame alignment checks, down tube deburring, tamper-evident lacquer on motor brackets, fork protector strapping, and the immediate Ledgerline quarantine routine exist only in meeting notes and are not formally codified in POL-QUA-005.
